name: Aechronis Hitboxes
description: Colors player and entity hitboxes by relationship (town/nation/ally/enemy) using Aechronis's Nodes map API. A stripped-down, from-source GPLv3 port of the hitbox-coloring feature from oreotrollturbo's CrusalisUtils (itself a fork of Hitbox+), retargeted from Crusalis to Aechronis.
